subject: design-technology
title: Levers & Linkages
welcome_lead: First, second, third class — the lever family.
meta_desc: KS3 D&T: lever classes, fulcrum, effort and load.
final_note: A lever multiplies force around a pivot.

concepts.def: Rigid bar that pivots around a fulcrum.

walkthroughs.body_html: First-class: fulcrum in middle (see-saw, scissors). Second-class: load in middle (wheelbarrow). Third-class: effort in middle (tweezers, fishing rod).
The longer the effort arm vs the load arm, the more force a lever multiplies. A long crowbar can shift loads many times heavier than the effort.
Linkages connect levers together so motion changes direction or amount. Bell-crank linkages turn vertical motion into horizontal — used in pop-up cards.
